    SELECT DISTINCT ?result

    }

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
    PREFIX wgs84: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
    PREFIX void: <http://rdfs.org/ns/void#>
    PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
    PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?result WHERE {
      # find people with expertise in sensors/wandler (transducers)
      ?person pv:areaOfExpertise ?exp .
      FILTER(regex(str(?exp), "sensor|wandler", "i"))

      # consider several ways a person can be linked to a department
      {
        ?dept pv:hasManager ?person .
      } UNION {
        ?dept pv:hasDirectReport ?person .
      } UNION {
        ?dept pv:responsibleFor ?person .
      } UNION {
        ?person pv:worksFor ?dept .
      }

      # ensure we only return department entities
      ?dept a pv:Department .

      OPTIONAL { ?dept rdfs:label ?label . }
      BIND(COALESCE(?label, STR(?dept)) AS ?result)
    }
    		 
    {}
    		 
    {
        "set_P": 0.0,
        "set_recall": 0.0,
        "set_F": 0.0
    }

    }

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?result WHERE {
      ?product pv:hasSupplier ?result .
      ?result a pv:Supplier .
      ?product rdfs:label ?productLabel .

      )
    }

    ck26:13-en 
    How many of our suppliers are based
    in France?
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?supplier) as ?result)
    WHERE
    {
      ?product pv:hasSupplier ?supplier .
      ?supplier pv:addressCountry "France" .
    }
    		 
    {
        "8": 1
    }
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
    PREFIX wgs84: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
    PREFIX void: <http://rdfs.org/ns/void#>
    PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
    PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

    SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?supplier) AS ?count) WHERE {
      ?supplier a pv:Supplier .
      ?supplier pv:country dbpedia:France .
    }
    		 
    {
        "9": 1
    }
    		 
    {
        "set_P": 0.0,
        "set_recall": 0.0,
        "set_F": 0.0
    }
    ck26:13-de 
    Wie viele unserer Lieferanten haben
    ihren Sitz in Frankreich?
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?supplier) as ?result)
    WHERE
    {
      ?product pv:hasSupplier ?supplier .
      ?supplier pv:addressCountry "France" .
    }
    		 
    {
        "8": 1
    }
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
    PREFIX wgs84: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
    PREFIX void: <http://rdfs.org/ns/void#>
    PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
    PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

    SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?supplier) AS ?count) WHERE {
      ?supplier a pv:Agent ;
                pv:addressCountry ?country .
      prodi:OurCompany pv:hasSupplier ?supplier .
      FILTER(
        ?country = dbpedia:France ||
        ?country = "France"@en ||
        ?country = "France"
      )
    }
    		 
    {
        "0": 1
    }
    		 
    {
        "set_P": 0.0,
        "set_recall": 0.0,
        "set_F": 0.0
    }

    SELECT DISTINCT ?result WHERE {

    ck26:14-de 
    Welcher Lieferant in Frankreich
    bietet Kompensatoren an?
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    SELECT DISTINCT ?result
    WHERE
    {
      ?product pv:hasSupplier ?result .
      ?product pv:hasCategory <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/prod-cat-Compensator> .
      ?result pv:addressCountry "France" .
    }
    		 
    {
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/suppl-2b70d47e-fa6a-4329-8112-22287096bc44": 1,
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/suppl-1ee8f22a-1460-4875-b1a8-89d7cb2607d6": 1,
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/suppl-22b9733f-4b49-4e82-82b9-d4f87d2b5916": 1
    }
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
    PREFIX wgs84: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
    PREFIX void: <http://rdfs.org/ns/void#>
    PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
    PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?result WHERE {
      ?result a pv:Agent ;
              pv:offers ?prod .
      OPTIONAL { ?result pv:addressText ?addr . }
      ?prod a pv:Product ;
            rdfs:label ?label .

      OPTIONAL {
        ?result pv:country ?country .
        ?country rdfs:label ?countryLabel .
      }

      FILTER(

      OPTIONAL { ?service pv:price ?priceLit . FILTER(isLiteral(?priceLit)) }

      OPTIONAL {

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    SELECT DISTINCT ?result

      ?supplier pv:country <http://dbpedia.org/resource/United_States> .

    {

        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/hw-A509-5571891": 1

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
    PREFIX dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?result WHERE {
      # find the U990-LCD inductor by label (flexible matching)
      ?inductor rdfs:label ?indLabel .
      FILTER regex(?indLabel, "U990\\s*-?LCD", "i") .

      # products compatible with that inductor (either direction)
      { ?result pv:compatibleProduct ?inductor . }
      UNION
      { ?inductor pv:compatibleProduct ?result . }

      # the product must have a supplier whose label or country indicates United States
      ?result pv:hasSupplier ?supplier .
      OPTIONAL { ?supplier rdfs:label ?supplierLabel . }
      OPTIONAL { ?supplier foaf:based_near ?basedNear . }
      OPTIONAL { ?supplier rdfs:comment ?supplierComment . }
      OPTIONAL { ?supplier pv:country ?supplierCountry . }
      OPTIONAL { ?supplier pv:basedIn ?supplierBasedIn . }

      FILTER(
        (bound(?supplierCountry) && ( ?supplierCountry = dbpedia:United_States || regex(str(?supplierCountry), "United States|USA|US|Vereinigte Staaten", "i") ))
        ||
        (bound(?supplierBasedIn) && ( ?supplierBasedIn = dbpedia:United_States || regex(str(?supplierBasedIn), "United States|USA|US|Vereinigte Staaten", "i") ))
        ||
        (bound(?supplierLabel) && regex(str(?supplierLabel), "\\b(United States|USA|US|Vereinigte Staaten)\\b", "i"))
        ||
        (bound(?supplierComment) && regex(str(?supplierComment), "United States|USA|Vereinigte Staaten", "i"))
        ||
        (bound(?basedNear) && regex(str(?basedNear), "United States|USA|Vereinigte Staaten", "i"))
      )
    }

      ?emp rdf:type pv:Employee ;
           pv:name ?name ;
           pv:email ?email ;
           pv:phone ?phone .
      FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?emp pv:hasDirectReport ?report . }
    }

    ck26:27-de 
    Könnten Sie ein Telefonverzeichnis
    für die Mitarbeiter erstellen, das
    den Namen, die E-Mail-Adresse und
    die Telefonnummer aller Mitarbeiter
    enthält, die keine leitende
    Position innehaben, und dieses
    alphabetisch nach Namen sortieren?
    		 
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?empl ?name ?email ?phone
    WHERE {
      ?emplClass rdfs:subClassOf* pv:Employee .
      ?empl a ?emplClass ;
          pv:name ?name ;
          pv:email ?email .
      OPTIONAL { ?empl pv:phone ?phone }
      FILTER NOT EXISTS { [] pv:hasManager ?empl . }
    }
    ORDER BY ?name

    ck26:28-en 
    Is there a service that can handle
    a BOM containing parts sourced from
    Russia?
    		 
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    ASK
    WHERE {
      { # all BOMs with parts from russia
        SELECT ?bom
        WHERE {
          ?bom pv:hasBomPart ?bomPart .
          ?bomPart pv:hasPart ?hw .
          ?hw pv:hasSupplier ?suppl .
          ?suppl pv:addressCountry ?country .
          FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(?country), LCASE("Russia")))
        }
      }

      # services eligible for parts associated with these BOMs?
      ?s a pv:Service .
      ?s pv:eligibleFor ?hw .
      ?bom pv:hasBomPart ?bomPart .
      ?bomPart pv:hasPart ?hw .
    }
    		 
    {
        "true": 1
    }
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

    ASK {
      ?service rdf:type pv:Service .
      ?service pv:responsibleFor ?bom .
      ?bom rdf:type pv:BillOfMaterial .
      ?bom pv:hasBomPart ?part .
      ?part rdf:type pv:BomPart .
      ?part pv:addressCountry dbpedia:Russia .
    }
    		 
    {
        "true": 0
    }
    		 
    {
        "set_P": 1.0,

        "set_F": 1.0

    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>

    Which departments have more than
    five employees, and could you list
    each department's name together
    with its employee count?
    		 
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?name (COUNT(?emp) AS ?numEmployees)
    WHERE {
      ?dept a pv:Department ;
        pv:name ?name .
      ?emp a pv:Employee ;
        pv:memberOf ?dept .
    }
    GROUP BY ?depty ?name
    HAVING (COUNT(?emp) > 5)

    PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

    SELECT ?dept ?name (COUNT(DISTINCT ?emp) AS ?numEmployees)
    WHERE {
      ?dept a pv:Department .
      OPTIONAL { ?dept rdfs:label ?label. }
      OPTIONAL { ?dept foaf:name ?fname. }
      BIND(COALESCE(?label, ?fname, STR(?dept)) AS ?name)

      {
        # Employees who are direct reports of the department's manager(s)
        ?dept pv:hasManager ?mgr .
        ?mgr pv:hasDirectReport ?emp .
      }
      UNION
      {
        # Employees who are members of the department (modeled that way)
        ?emp pv:memberOf ?dept .
      }
    }
    GROUP BY ?dept ?name
    HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?emp) > 5)
    ORDER BY DESC(?numEmployees)

    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?category ?lightest ?minWeight ?heaviest ?maxWeight WHERE {
      {
        SELECT ?category (MIN(?w) AS ?minWeight) (MAX(?w) AS ?maxWeight) WHERE {
          ?category a pv:ProductCategory .
          ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
              pv:hasCategory ?category ;
              pv:weight ?w .
        } GROUP BY ?category
      }
      # hardware item(s) matching the minimum weight for the category
      ?lightest a pv:Hardware ;
                pv:hasCategory ?category ;
                pv:weight ?minWeight .
      # hardware item(s) matching the maximum weight for the category
      ?heaviest a pv:Hardware ;
                pv:hasCategory ?category ;
                pv:weight ?maxWeight .
    }

    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?category ?lightestProd ?lightestWeight ?heaviestProd ?heaviestWeight
    WHERE {
      {
        SELECT ?category (MIN(?w) AS ?minW) (MAX(?w) AS ?maxW)
        WHERE {
          ?p rdf:type pv:HardwareProduct ;
             pv:hasCategory ?category ;
             pv:weight ?w .
        }
        GROUP BY ?category
      }

      # products that match the min weight for the category
      ?lightestProd rdf:type pv:HardwareProduct ;
                    pv:hasCategory ?category ;
                    pv:weight ?lightestWeight .
      FILTER(?lightestWeight = ?minW)

      # products that match the max weight for the category
      ?heaviestProd rdf:type pv:HardwareProduct ;
                    pv:hasCategory ?category ;
                    pv:weight ?heaviestWeight .
      FILTER(?heaviestWeight = ?maxW)
    }

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?supplier ( (ROUND(AVG(xsd:decimal(?amount)) * 100) / 100) AS ?avgEur )
    WHERE {
      ?product a pv:Product ;
               pv:hasSupplier ?supplier ;
               pv:price ?price .
      ?price pv:amount ?amount ;
             pv:currency "EUR" .
    }
    GROUP BY ?supplier

        "set_P": 0.0,

        "set_F": 0.0

    ck26:32-de 
    Was ist der durchschnittliche Preis
    in Euro für die Produkte jedes
    Anbieters, gerundet auf einen
    angemessenen Betrag?
    		 
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?name (ROUND(AVG(?amt) * 100) / 100 AS ?avgEur) WHERE {
      ?sup a pv:Supplier ;
        pv:name ?name .
      ?hw pv:hasSupplier ?sup ;
        pv:price/pv:amount ?amt ;
        pv:price/pv:currency "EUR" .
    }
    GROUP BY ?sup ?name

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
    PREFIX dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>

    ASK {
      {
        SELECT ?provider ((ROUND(AVG(xsd:decimal(?price)) * 100) / 100) AS ?avgRounded)
        WHERE {
          ?product pv:hasProvider ?provider ;
                   pv:price ?price ;
                   pv:priceCurrency ?currency .
          FILTER(
            STR(?currency) = "EUR" ||
            ?currency = dbpedia:Euro
          )
        }
        GROUP BY ?provider
        LIMIT 1
      }
    }
    		 
    {
        "true": 0
    }
    		 
    {
        "set_P": 0.0,
        "set_recall": 0.0,
        "set_F": 0.0
    }
    ck26:33-en 
    Do any departments lack an assigned
    manager?
    		 
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

    ASK
    WHERE {
      ?dept a pv:Department .
      FILTER NOT EXISTS {
        ?m pv:memberOf ?dept .
        ?m a pv:Manager .
      }
    }
    		 
    {
        "true": 0
    }
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
    PREFIX wgs84: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
    PREFIX void: <http://rdfs.org/ns/void#>
    PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
    PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

    ASK {
      ?dept rdf:type pv:Department .
      FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?dept pv:hasManager ?mgr }
    }
    		 
    {
        "true": 1
    }
    		 
    {
        "set_P": 0.0,
        "set_recall": 0.0,
        "set_F": 0.0
    }
    ck26:33-de 
    Gibt es Abteilungen, denen kein
    Verantwortlicher zugewiesen ist?
    		 
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

    ASK
    WHERE {
      ?dept a pv:Department .
      FILTER NOT EXISTS {
        ?m pv:memberOf ?dept .
        ?m a pv:Manager .
      }
    }
    		 
    {
        "true": 0
    }
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?result WHERE {
      ?result a pv:Department .
      FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?result pv:hasManager ?mgr . }
    }

    ck26:34-en 
    I need to refresh my supplier
    contact list by collecting each
    supplier's name along with their
    full address information.
    		 
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?name ?locality ?ccode ?country
    WHERE {
      ?sup a pv:Supplier ;
        pv:name ?name .
      OPTIONAL { ?sup pv:addressLocality ?locality . }
      OPTIONAL { ?sup pv:addressCountryCode ?ccode . }
      OPTIONAL { ?sup pv:addressCountry ?country . }
    }

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?supplier ?name ?addressText ?addressLocality ?addressCountry ?addressCountryCode
    WHERE {
      ?supplier a pv:Supplier .
      OPTIONAL { ?supplier pv:name ?name. }
      OPTIONAL { ?supplier pv:addressText ?addressText. }
      OPTIONAL { ?supplier pv:addressLocality ?addressLocality. }
      OPTIONAL { ?supplier pv:addressCountry ?addressCountry. }
      OPTIONAL { ?supplier pv:addressCountryCode ?addressCountryCode. }
    }
    ORDER BY ?name

    ck26:34-de 
    Ich muss meine
    Lieferantenkontaktliste
    aktualisieren, indem ich die Namen
    aller Lieferanten sowie deren
    vollständige Adressdaten erfasse.
    		 
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?name ?locality ?ccode ?country
    WHERE {
      ?sup a pv:Supplier ;
        pv:name ?name .
      OPTIONAL { ?sup pv:addressLocality ?locality . }
      OPTIONAL { ?sup pv:addressCountryCode ?ccode . }
      OPTIONAL { ?sup pv:addressCountry ?country . }
    }

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
    PREFIX wgs84: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
    PREFIX void: <http://rdfs.org/ns/void#>
    PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
    PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?supplier ?chosenName ?street ?postalCode ?locality ?country ?lat ?long WHERE {
      ?supplier a pv:Supplier .

      OPTIONAL { ?supplier foaf:name ?name. }
      OPTIONAL { ?supplier rdfs:label ?label. }

      OPTIONAL { ?supplier pv:addressStreet ?street. }
      OPTIONAL { ?supplier pv:addressPostalCode ?postalCode. }
      OPTIONAL { ?supplier pv:addressLocality ?locality. }
      OPTIONAL { ?supplier pv:addressCountry ?country. }

      OPTIONAL { ?supplier wgs84:lat ?lat. }
      OPTIONAL { ?supplier wgs84:long ?long. }

      # choose a name (foaf:name, rdfs:label, or the resource IRI as fallback)
      BIND(COALESCE(?name, ?label, STR(?supplier)) AS ?chosenName)

      # build a single textual result containing name and full address components
      BIND(
        CONCAT(
          ?chosenName,
          " | ",
          COALESCE(?street, ""),
          IF(bound(?street), ", ", ""),
          COALESCE(?postalCode, ""),
          IF(bound(?postalCode) && bound(?locality), " ", ""),
          COALESCE(?locality, ""),
          IF(bound(?country), ", ", ""),
          COALESCE(?country, ""),
          IF(bound(?lat) && bound(?long),
             CONCAT(" (lat:", STR(?lat), ", long:", STR(?long), ")"),
             ""
          )
        ) AS ?result
      )
    }

    ck26:35-en 
    For each product, could you list
    the other products it's compatible
    with and show the price differences
    between them?
    		 
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv:    <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?prod ?compatible (?prodAmount - ?compatibleAmount AS ?priceDiff)
    WHERE {
      ?prodClass rdfs:subClassOf* pv:Product .
      ?prod a ?prodClass ;
        pv:compatibleProduct ?compatible .
      ?prod pv:price/pv:amount ?prodAmount ;
        pv:price/pv:currency "EUR" .
      ?compatible pv:price/pv:amount ?compatibleAmount ;
        pv:price/pv:currency "EUR" .
    }

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
    PREFIX wgs84: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
    PREFIX void: <http://rdfs.org/ns/void#>
    PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
    PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?product ?productName ?compatible ?compatibleName ?price ?compatiblePrice ?priceDifference
    WHERE {
      ?product a pv:Product ;
               pv:compatibleProduct ?compatible .
      ?compatible a pv:Product .
      FILTER(?product != ?compatible)

      OPTIONAL { ?product rdfs:label ?productName. }
      OPTIONAL { ?compatible rdfs:label ?compatibleName. }

      OPTIONAL { ?product pv:price ?price. }
      OPTIONAL { ?compatible pv:price ?compatiblePrice. }

      OPTIONAL {
        FILTER(BOUND(?price) && BOUND(?compatiblePrice))
        BIND(xsd:decimal(?price) AS ?p1)
        BIND(xsd:decimal(?compatiblePrice) AS ?p2)
        BIND((?p1 - ?p2) AS ?priceDifference)
      }
    }
    		 
    {}
    		 
    {
        "set_P": 0.0,
        "set_recall": 0.0,
        "set_F": 0.0
    }
    ck26:35-de 
    Könnten Sie für jedes Produkt
    auflisten, mit welchen anderen
    Produkten es kompatibel ist, und
    die Preisunterschiede zwischen
    diesen Produkten anzeigen?
    		 
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv:    <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?prod ?compatible (?prodAmount - ?compatibleAmount AS ?priceDiff)
    WHERE {
      ?prodClass rdfs:subClassOf* pv:Product .
      ?prod a ?prodClass ;
        pv:compatibleProduct ?compatible .
      ?prod pv:price/pv:amount ?prodAmount ;
        pv:price/pv:currency "EUR" .
      ?compatible pv:price/pv:amount ?compatibleAmount ;
        pv:price/pv:currency "EUR" .
    }

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?product ?productLabel ?compatible ?compatibleLabel ?price ?compatiblePrice ?priceDiff
    WHERE {
      ?product pv:compatibleProduct ?compatible .
      FILTER(?product != ?compatible)

      OPTIONAL { ?product rdfs:label ?productLabel . }
      OPTIONAL { ?compatible rdfs:label ?compatibleLabel . }

      OPTIONAL { ?product pv:price ?priceInst . ?priceInst rdf:value ?price . }
      OPTIONAL { ?compatible pv:price ?compatiblePriceInst . ?compatiblePriceInst rdf:value ?compatiblePrice . }

      BIND(
        IF(
          isLiteral(?price) && isLiteral(?compatiblePrice)
          && regex(str(?price), "^[+-]?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$") 
          && regex(str(?compatiblePrice), "^[+-]?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$"),
          STR(ABS(xsd:decimal(str(?price)) - xsd:decimal(str(?compatiblePrice)))),
          "unknown"
        ) AS ?priceDiff
      )
    }

    ck26:36-en 
    Which product area is most
    relevant, and what are the top
    three associated skills?
    		 
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?cat ?name
    WHERE {
      ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
        pv:hasCategory ?cat .
      ?cat pv:name ?name .
    }
    GROUP BY ?cat ?name
    ORDER BY DESC(COUNT(*))
    LIMIT 3
    		 
    {
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/prod-cat-Compensator": 1,
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/prod-cat-Crystal": 1,
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/prod-cat-LCD": 1,
        "Compensator": 1,
        "Crystal": 1,
        "LCD": 1
    }
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?area ?skill ?skillCount WHERE {
      {
        # Find the single most relevant product area (by number of products assigned)
        SELECT ?area (COUNT(DISTINCT ?p) AS ?prodCount) WHERE {
          ?p a pv:Product ;
             pv:areaOfExpertise ?area .
        }
        GROUP BY ?area
        ORDER BY DESC(?prodCount)
        LIMIT 1
      }
      {
        # For that area, find the top three associated skills (by how many products require them)
        SELECT ?area ?skill (COUNT(DISTINCT ?p2) AS ?skillCount) WHERE {
          ?p2 a pv:Product ;
              pv:areaOfExpertise ?area ;
              pv:requiresSkill ?skill .
        }
        GROUP BY ?area ?skill
      }
    }
    ORDER BY DESC(?skillCount)
    LIMIT 3
    		 
    {}
    		 
    {
        "set_P": 0.0,
        "set_recall": 0.0,
        "set_F": 0.0
    }

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?cat ?name
    WHERE {
      ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
        pv:hasCategory ?cat .
      ?cat pv:name ?name .
    }
    GROUP BY ?cat ?name
    ORDER BY DESC(COUNT(*))
    LIMIT 3

        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/prod-cat-Compensator": 1,
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/prod-cat-Crystal": 1,
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/prod-cat-LCD": 1,
        "Compensator": 1,
        "Crystal": 1,
        "LCD": 1
    }
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?productArea ?skill ?skillScore WHERE {
      {
        SELECT ?productArea WHERE {
          ?productArea a pv:ProductCategory ;
                       pv:reliabilityIndex ?catScore .
        } ORDER BY DESC(?catScore) LIMIT 1
      }
      ?productArea pv:hasManager ?skill .
      OPTIONAL { ?skill pv:reliabilityIndex ?skillScore . }
    }
    ORDER BY DESC(?skillScore)
    LIMIT 3

    ck26:37-en 
    For each bill of materials, show
    the count of parts and the total
    material quantity, but display only
    those BOMs with more than 600
    items, sorted in descending order.
    		 
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?bom (COUNT(?part) AS ?partCount) (SUM(?qty) AS ?totalQty)
    WHERE {
      ?bom a pv:BillOfMaterial ;
        pv:hasBomPart ?part .
      ?part pv:quantity ?qty_ .
      BIND(xsd:int(?qty_) AS ?qty)
    }
    GROUP BY ?bom
    HAVING (SUM(?qty) > 600)
    ORDER BY DESC(SUM(?qty))

    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

    SELECT ?bom (COUNT(DISTINCT ?part) AS ?partsCount) (SUM(xsd:decimal(?qty)) AS ?totalQuantity)
    WHERE {
      ?bom a pv:BillOfMaterial .

    ck26:38-en 
    Could you give me an updated
    contact list that includes each
    employee's name, email, phone
    number, department, and direct
    manager?
    		 
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?name ?email ?phone ?dept ?manager
    WHERE {
      ?agentClass rdfs:subClassOf* pv:Agent .
      ?empl a ?agentClass ;
        pv:name ?name .
      OPTIONAL { ?empl pv:email ?email . }
      OPTIONAL { ?empl pv:phone ?phone . }
      OPTIONAL { ?empl pv:memberOf/pv:name ?dept . }
      OPTIONAL { ?empl pv:hasManager/pv:name ?manager . }
    }

    ck26:38-de 
    Könnten Sie mir bitte eine
    aktualisierte Kontaktliste zukommen
    lassen, die den Namen, die E-Mail-
    Adresse, die Telefonnummer, die
    Abteilung und den direkten
    Vorgesetzten jedes Mitarbeiters
    enthält?
    		 
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?name ?email ?phone ?dept ?manager
    WHERE {
      ?agentClass rdfs:subClassOf* pv:Agent .
      ?empl a ?agentClass ;
        pv:name ?name .
      OPTIONAL { ?empl pv:email ?email . }
      OPTIONAL { ?empl pv:phone ?phone . }
      OPTIONAL { ?empl pv:memberOf/pv:name ?dept . }
      OPTIONAL { ?empl pv:hasManager/pv:name ?manager . }
    }

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?name ?email ?phone ?deptName ?mgrName WHERE {
      # employees (use the Employee class)
      ?emp a pv:Employee .

      OPTIONAL { ?emp foaf:name ?name. }
      OPTIONAL { ?emp foaf:mbox ?email. }
      OPTIONAL { ?emp foaf:phone ?phone. }

      # department (optional). If departments use rdfs:label, prefer that.
      OPTIONAL {
        ?emp pv:department ?dept .
        OPTIONAL { ?dept rdfs:label ?deptName. }
      }

      # direct manager (optional) — support manager property on the employee
      OPTIONAL {
        ?emp pv:hasManager ?mgr .
        OPTIONAL { ?mgr foaf:name ?mgrName. }
      }

      # Construct a single result string: Name | Email | Phone | Department | Manager
      BIND(
        CONCAT(
          COALESCE(STR(?name), ""),
          " | ",
          COALESCE(STR(?email), ""),
          " | ",
          COALESCE(STR(?phone), ""),
          " | ",
          COALESCE(STR(?deptName), COALESCE(STR(?dept), "")),
          " | ",
          COALESCE(STR(?mgrName), COALESCE(STR(?mgr), ""))
        ) AS ?result
      )
    }
    		 
    {}
    		 
    {
        "set_P": 0.0,
        "set_recall": 0.0,
        "set_F": 0.0
    }
    ck26:39-en 
    Can you list the dimensions of
    hardware items that are wider than
    they are tall and have a depth
    under 50 mm?
    		 
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?hw ?width ?height ?depth
    WHERE {
      ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
        pv:width_mm ?width ;
        pv:height_mm ?height ;
        pv:depth_mm ?depth .
      FILTER (?width > ?height && ?depth < 50)
    }

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

    SELECT ?w ?h ?d WHERE {
      ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
          pv:width_mm ?w ;
          pv:height_mm ?h ;
          pv:depth_mm ?d .
      FILTER( xsd:decimal(?w) > xsd:decimal(?h) && xsd:decimal(?d) < xsd:decimal("50") )
    }

    ck26:39-de 
    Können Sie die Abmessungen von
    Hardware-Artikeln auflisten, die
    breiter als hoch sind und eine
    Tiefe von unter 50 mm haben?
    		 
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?hw ?width ?height ?depth
    WHERE {
      ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
        pv:width_mm ?width ;
        pv:height_mm ?height ;
        pv:depth_mm ?depth .
      FILTER (?width > ?height && ?depth < 50)
    }

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
    PREFIX wgs84: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
    PREFIX void: <http://rdfs.org/ns/void#>
    PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
    PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?result WHERE {
      ?item rdf:type pv:Hardware ;
            pv:width_mm ?width ;
            pv:height_mm ?height ;
            pv:depth_mm ?depth .
      FILTER( xsd:decimal(?width) > xsd:decimal(?height) && xsd:decimal(?depth) < "50"^^xsd:decimal )
      BIND(CONCAT(STR(?item), " width=", STR(?width), "mm; height=", STR(?height), "mm; depth=", STR(?depth), "mm") AS ?result)
    }

    ck26:40-en 
    Could you list the IDs and names of
    hardware items that don't have an
    active product manager?
    		 
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?hw ?id ?name
    WHERE {
      ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
        pv:id ?id ;
        pv:name ?name .
      FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?hw pv:hasProductManager/pv:name [] . }
    }

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

    SELECT ?id ?name WHERE {
      ?hw a pv:Hardware .
      FILTER NOT EXISTS {
        ?hw pv:hasProductManager ?pm .
        {
          ?pm a pv:ActiveManager
        } UNION {
          ?pm pv:status ?st .
          FILTER(lcase(str(?st)) = "active")
        }
      }

      OPTIONAL { ?hw rdfs:label ?lbl1 . }
      OPTIONAL { ?hw foaf:name ?lbl2 . }
      BIND(COALESCE(?lbl1, ?lbl2) AS ?name)

      BIND(REPLACE(STR(?hw), "^.*/", "") AS ?id)
    }

    ck26:40-de 
    Könnten Sie die IDs und Namen der
    Hardware-Artikel auflisten, die
    keinen aktiven Produktmanager
    haben?
    		 
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?hw ?id ?name
    WHERE {
      ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
        pv:id ?id ;
        pv:name ?name .
      FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?hw pv:hasProductManager/pv:name [] . }
    }

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?id ?name WHERE {
      ?hw ?p ?o .
      FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?hw), "/prod-instances/hw-")) .

      OPTIONAL { ?hw rdfs:label ?lbl . }
      OPTIONAL { ?hw foaf:name ?fn . }
      BIND(COALESCE(?lbl, ?fn, "") AS ?name) .
      BIND(REPLACE(STR(?hw), STR(<http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>), "") AS ?id) .

      FILTER NOT EXISTS {
        ?hw pv:productManager ?pm .
        ?pm pv:status "active" .
      }
    }

    ck26:41-en 
    What share of each manager's
    overall team works in the same
    department as the manager?
    		 
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?m ?name (?deptTeam / ?fullteam * 100 AS ?pct)
    WHERE {

      ?m pv:name ?name .

      { # full team
        SELECT ?m (COUNT(*) AS ?fullteam) WHERE {
          ?e pv:hasManager ?m .
        } GROUP BY ?m
      }

      { # team in same dept
        SELECT ?m (COUNT(*) AS ?deptTeam) WHERE {
          ?m pv:memberOf ?dept .
          ?e pv:hasManager ?m .
          ?e pv:memberOf ?dept .
        } GROUP BY ?m
      }
    }
    		 
    {
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/empl-Dietlinde.Boehme%40company.org": 1,
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/empl-Waldtraud.Kuttner%40company.org": 1,
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/empl-Thomas.Mueller%40company.org": 1,
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/empl-Reiner.Widmann%40company.org": 1,
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/empl-Elena.Herzog%40company.org": 1,
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/empl-Franz.Kornhaeusel%40company.org": 1,
        "Dietlinde Boehme": 1,
        "Waldtraud Kuttner": 1,
        "Thomas Mueller": 1,
        "Reiner Widmann": 1,
        "Elena Herzog": 1,
        "Franz Kornhaeusel": 1,
        "100.0": 1
    }
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?manager ?share WHERE {
      {
        SELECT ?manager ?dept (SUM(IF(BOUND(?deptEmp) && ?deptEmp = ?dept, 1, 0)) AS ?same) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?employee) AS ?total) WHERE {
          ?manager a pv:Manager .
          ?manager pv:department ?dept .
          ?employee pv:hasManager ?manager .
          OPTIONAL { ?employee pv:department ?deptEmp . }
        } GROUP BY ?manager ?dept
      }
      BIND( IF(?total > 0, xsd:decimal(?same) / xsd:decimal(?total), xsd:decimal(0)) AS ?share )
    }
    		 
    {}
    		 
    {
        "set_P": 0.0,
        "set_recall": 0.0,
        "set_F": 0.0
    }
    ck26:41-de 
    Welcher Anteil der Teammitglieder
    jedes Managers arbeitet in
    derselben Abteilung wie der Manager
    selbst?
    		 
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?m ?name (?deptTeam / ?fullteam * 100 AS ?pct)
    WHERE {

      ?m pv:name ?name .

      { # full team
        SELECT ?m (COUNT(*) AS ?fullteam) WHERE {
          ?e pv:hasManager ?m .
        } GROUP BY ?m
      }

      { # team in same dept
        SELECT ?m (COUNT(*) AS ?deptTeam) WHERE {
          ?m pv:memberOf ?dept .
          ?e pv:hasManager ?m .
          ?e pv:memberOf ?dept .
        } GROUP BY ?m
      }
    }
    		 
    {
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/empl-Dietlinde.Boehme%40company.org": 1,
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/empl-Waldtraud.Kuttner%40company.org": 1,
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/empl-Thomas.Mueller%40company.org": 1,
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/empl-Reiner.Widmann%40company.org": 1,
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/empl-Elena.Herzog%40company.org": 1,
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/empl-Franz.Kornhaeusel%40company.org": 1,
        "Dietlinde Boehme": 1,
        "Waldtraud Kuttner": 1,
        "Thomas Mueller": 1,
        "Reiner Widmann": 1,
        "Elena Herzog": 1,
        "Franz Kornhaeusel": 1,
        "100.0": 1
    }
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?manager ?dept (COUNT(DISTINCT ?member) AS ?totalMembers)
           (SUM(IF(BOUND(?mdept) && ?mdept = ?dept, 1, 0)) AS ?sameDeptMembers)
           (xsd:decimal(SUM(IF(BOUND(?mdept) && ?mdept = ?dept, 1, 0))) / xsd:decimal(COUNT(DISTINCT ?member)) AS ?shareSameDept)
    WHERE {
      ?manager pv:hasDirectReport ?member .
      ?manager pv:worksIn ?dept .
      OPTIONAL { ?member pv:worksIn ?mdept . }
      FILTER(?member != ?manager)
    }
    GROUP BY ?manager ?dept
    HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?member) > 0)

    ck26:42-en 
    Which bill of materials has the
    highest average unit cost for its
    hardware components, and what is
    that average?
    		 
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?bom (ROUND(AVG(?spst / ?sq) * 100) / 100 AS ?avgUnitCost)
    WHERE {
      {
        SELECT ?bom (SUM(?partSubTotal) AS ?spst) (SUM(xsd:int(?quant)) AS ?sq)
        WHERE {
          ?bom a pv:BillOfMaterial ;
            pv:hasBomPart ?part .
          ?part pv:quantity ?quant .
          ?part pv:hasPart/pv:price/pv:amount ?amount .
          ?part pv:hasPart/pv:price/pv:currency "EUR" .
          BIND(xsd:int(?quant) * ?amount AS ?partSubTotal)
        }
        GROUP BY ?bom
      }
    }
    GROUP BY ?bom
    ORDER BY DESC(ROUND(AVG(?spst / ?sq) * 100) / 100)
    LIMIT 1
    		 
    {
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/bom-8": 1,
        "4.22": 1
    }
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

    SELECT ?bom (AVG(xsd:double(?cost)) AS ?avgUnitCost)
    WHERE {
      ?bom a pv:BillOfMaterial ;
           pv:hasBomPart ?hw .
      ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
          pv:unitPrice ?cost .
    }
    GROUP BY ?bom
    ORDER BY DESC(?avgUnitCost)
    LIMIT 1
    		 
    {}

    ck26:42-de 
    Welche Stückliste hat die höchsten
    durchschnittlichen Stückkosten für
    ihre Hardwarekomponenten, und wie
    hoch sind diese durchschnittlichen
    Kosten?
    		 
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?bom (ROUND(AVG(?spst / ?sq) * 100) / 100 AS ?avgUnitCost)
    WHERE {
      {
        SELECT ?bom (SUM(?partSubTotal) AS ?spst) (SUM(xsd:int(?quant)) AS ?sq)
        WHERE {
          ?bom a pv:BillOfMaterial ;
            pv:hasBomPart ?part .
          ?part pv:quantity ?quant .
          ?part pv:hasPart/pv:price/pv:amount ?amount .
          ?part pv:hasPart/pv:price/pv:currency "EUR" .
          BIND(xsd:int(?quant) * ?amount AS ?partSubTotal)
        }
        GROUP BY ?bom
      }
    }
    GROUP BY ?bom
    ORDER BY DESC(ROUND(AVG(?spst / ?sq) * 100) / 100)
    LIMIT 1
    		 
    {
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/bom-8": 1,
        "4.22": 1
    }
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
    PREFIX wgs84: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
    PREFIX void: <http://rdfs.org/ns/void#>
    PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
    PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?bom (AVG(xsd:decimal(?cost)) AS ?avgCost)
    WHERE {
      ?bom a pv:BillOfMaterial ;
           pv:hasComponent ?hw .
      ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
          pv:unitCost ?cost .
    }
    GROUP BY ?bom
    ORDER BY DESC(?avgCost)
    LIMIT 1

    ck26:43-en 
    Could you list any product
    compatibility cycles—instances
    where product A states it's
    compatible with product B and
    product B likewise lists product A
    as compatible?
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?a ?b
    WHERE {
      ?a pv:compatibleProduct ?b .
      FILTER (STR(?a) < STR(?b))
    }

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
    PREFIX wgs84: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
    PREFIX void: <http://rdfs.org/ns/void#>
    PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
    PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

    ASK WHERE {
      ?a a pv:Product ;
         pv:compatibleProduct ?b .
      ?b a pv:Product ;
         pv:compatibleProduct ?a .
      FILTER(?a != ?b)
      FILTER(str(?a) < str(?b))
    }
    		 
    {
        "true": 0
    }
    		 
    {
        "set_P": 0.0,
        "set_recall": 0.0,
        "set_F": 0.0
    }
    ck26:43-de 
    Könnten Sie Beispiele für
    Produktkompatibilitätszyklen nennen
    - Fälle, in denen Produkt A angibt,
    dass es mit Produkt B kompatibel
    ist, und Produkt B wiederum Produkt
    A als kompatibel auflistet?
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?a ?b
    WHERE {
      ?a pv:compatibleProduct ?b .
      FILTER (STR(?a) < STR(?b))
    }

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?result WHERE {
      ?a pv:compatibleProduct ?b .
      ?b pv:compatibleProduct ?a .
      FILTER(str(?a) < str(?b))
      BIND(CONCAT(STR(?a), " <-> ", STR(?b)) AS ?result)
    }

    ck26:44-en 
    Which hardware items fall within
    the top 10% of widths, and what are
    their IDs, names, and width
    measurements?
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?id ?name ?width
    WHERE {
      { # get min-max range
        SELECT (MIN(?width) AS ?minW) (MAX(?width) AS ?maxW)
        WHERE {
          ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
            pv:width_mm ?width .
        }
      }

      # get 90. percentile
      BIND(?minW + (0.9 * (?maxW - ?minW)) AS ?pct90)

      ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
        pv:id ?id ;
        pv:name ?name ;
        pv:width_mm ?width .

      FILTER(?width >= ?pct90)
    }
    ORDER BY DESC(?width)

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    SELECT DISTINCT ?hw ?label ?width WHERE {
      {
        SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?hAll) AS ?total) WHERE {
          ?hAll rdf:type pv:Hardware ;
                pv:width_mm ?wAll .
        }
      }
      BIND(CEIL(?total * 0.1) AS ?topCount)
      ?hw rdf:type pv:Hardware ;
          pv:width_mm ?width .
      OPTIONAL { ?hw rdfs:label ?label. }
      {
        SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?h2) AS ?higher) WHERE {
          ?h2 rdf:type pv:Hardware ;
              pv:width_mm ?w2 .
          FILTER(?w2 > ?width)
        }
      }
      BIND((?higher + 1) AS ?rank)
      FILTER(?rank <= ?topCount)
    }
    ORDER BY DESC(?width)

    ck26:44-de 
    Welche Hardware-Komponenten gehören
    zu den 10% mit der größten Breite,
    und welche IDs, Namen und
    Breitenmaße haben sie?
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

    SELECT ?id ?name ?width
    WHERE {
      { # get min-max range
        SELECT (MIN(?width) AS ?minW) (MAX(?width) AS ?maxW)
        WHERE {
          ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
            pv:width_mm ?width .
        }
      }

      # get 90. percentile
      BIND(?minW + (0.9 * (?maxW - ?minW)) AS ?pct90)

      ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
        pv:id ?id ;
        pv:name ?name ;
        pv:width_mm ?width .

      FILTER(?width >= ?pct90)
    }
    ORDER BY DESC(?width)

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?id ?name ?width WHERE {
      {
        SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?x) AS ?cnt) WHERE {
          ?x pv:width ?w .
          ?x rdf:type pv:HardwareComponent .
        }
      }
      BIND(CEIL(xsd:decimal(?cnt) * 0.1) AS ?topN)

      {
        SELECT ?hw ?width ?name (COUNT(DISTINCT ?other) AS ?higherCount) WHERE {
          ?hw pv:width ?width .
          ?hw rdf:type pv:HardwareComponent .
          OPTIONAL { ?hw rdfs:label ?name . }
          ?other pv:width ?otherWidth .
          ?other rdf:type pv:HardwareComponent .
          FILTER(xsd:decimal(?otherWidth) > xsd:decimal(?width))
        }
        GROUP BY ?hw ?width ?name
      }

      FILTER((?higherCount + 1) <= ?topN)
      BIND(?hw AS ?id)
    }
    		 
    {}

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
    PREFIX wgs84: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
    PREFIX void: <http://rdfs.org/ns/void#>
    PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
    PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

    SELECT DISTINCT ?result WHERE {
      {
        SELECT ?s (AVG(xsd:double(?rel)) AS ?avg) WHERE {
          ?s a pv:Agent .
          ?s pv:provides ?prod .
          ?prod rdfs:label ?label .
          FILTER(regex(lcase(str(?label)), "indukt")) .
          ?prod pv:reliability ?rel .
        } GROUP BY ?s
      }
      {
        SELECT (MAX(?avg2) AS ?maxAvg) WHERE {
          {
            SELECT ?s2 (AVG(xsd:double(?rel2)) AS ?avg2) WHERE {
              ?s2 a pv:Agent .
              ?s2 pv:provides ?prod2 .
              ?prod2 rdfs:label ?label2 .
              FILTER(regex(lcase(str(?label2)), "indukt")) .
              ?prod2 pv:reliability ?rel2 .
            } GROUP BY ?s2
          }
        }
      }
      FILTER(ABS(xsd:double(?avg) - xsd:double(?maxAvg)) < 1e-6)
      BIND(?s AS ?result)
    }

    SELECT DISTINCT (COUNT(?supplier) AS ?result)
    WHERE

    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>

      {
        prodi:hw-K367-1320550 pv:compatibleProduct ?alt .
      } UNION {
        ?alt pv:compatibleProduct prodi:hw-K367-1320550 .
      }
      FILTER (?alt != prodi:hw-K367-1320550)
      ?supplier a pv:Supplier .
      ?supplier pv:offersProduct ?alt .

    ck26:50-en 
    Which department is responsible for
    the most products, and how many
    products is that?
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    SELECT DISTINCT ?result (COUNT(?result) AS ?count)
    WHERE
    {
      ?result pv:responsibleFor ?product .
    }
    GROUP BY ?result
    ORDER BY DESC(?count)
    LIMIT 1
    		 
    {
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/dept-85880": 1,
        "12": 1
    }
    		 
    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
    PREFIX wgs84: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
    PREFIX void: <http://rdfs.org/ns/void#>
    PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
    PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

    SELECT ?department (COUNT(DISTINCT ?product) AS ?count)
    WHERE {
      ?department a pv:Department ;
                  pv:responsibleFor ?product .
      ?product a pv:Product .
    }
    GROUP BY ?department
    ORDER BY DESC(?count)
    LIMIT 1

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    SELECT DISTINCT ?result (COUNT(?result) AS ?count)

    PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
    PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
    PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
    PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

    SELECT ?dept ?deptName ?count WHERE {
      {
        SELECT ?dept (COALESCE(?label, STR(?dept)) AS ?deptName) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?product) AS ?count) WHERE {
          ?product pv:hasProductManager ?mgr .
          ?mgr pv:hasManager ?dept .
          OPTIONAL { ?dept rdfs:label ?label. }
        }
        GROUP BY ?dept ?label
        ORDER BY DESC(?count)
        LIMIT 1
      }
    }
    		 
    {
        "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/empl-Franz.Kornhaeusel%40company.org": 1,
        "Franz Kornhaeusel": 1,
        "224": 1
    }
    		 
    {
        "set_P": 0.0,
        "set_recall": 0.0,
        "set_F": 0.0
    }
